actualUseEvidence.locator: Section 4 ("We randomly selected 10% of AbdomenAtlas 3.0 as a test set"), Appendix B.1 (training on AbdomenAtlas 3.0), Table 2; README "Train/Test Splits"
actualUseEvidence.note: The paper introduces the release and evaluates six report generation models on its test set. Three of them were trained on the remaining scans.

subset: All 9,262 scans, using the IID split with 926 test scans (IID_test.csv). The README says the paper used this split.
preprocessing: CT2Rep, CT-CHAT and Merlin were trained on the CT scans and structured reports only, without the masks. CT2Rep and CT-CHAT used CT resampled to 1.5 mm isotropic voxels (Appendix B.1).
split: IID: random 90% train (8,336) / 10% test (926). The paper also tests on a private UCSF set, not part of this release.
